_comment: SIMULATED student answers for the province-economy golden fixture, authored for the report-presentation golden set. Not real student material. Scoped to the author's own work (author-scope filter); the two out-of-scope denied candidates from the raw archive are not referenced.

confirmations.student_statement: 算法是先在终端跑通的，能输出分省年度结果后才开始对接可视化；缓存机制是因为每次重算太慢才加的。没有写自动化测试。
「测试前」是联调前的存档点。图表修复是靠页面人工核对的，切换年份和省份点一遍看渲染对不对，没有留测试记录。
